name: Redact personal data in a folder of documents (DPDP)
description: Runs offline, no AI. Makes redacted copies of every document in data/redact/inbox (PDF, scanned PDF, Word, Excel, picture, text, CSV) in output/redacted, keeping the folder structure; the originals are not changed. Finds PAN, Aadhaar (checksum-verified), mobile numbers, e-mail, bank accounts, IFSC, cards, UPI IDs, passport, voter ID, driving licence, and labelled details (Name, DOB, Age, Sex, UHID, Diagnosis, Address, PIN), plus the names in data/redact/names_to_redact.txt and a company pattern (EMP-12345). Writes a CSV report with counts only. A file that cannot be redacted completely is not written and stops the flow, so nothing half-redacted is passed on. Point input_folder at your own folder of thousands of files.

steps.message: ${redaction.files} file(s): ${redaction.redacted} redacted, ${redaction.clean} clean, ${redaction.skipped} skipped, ${redaction.failed} failed. Report: ${output_folder}/redaction_report.csv
